rationale: PINS the four defect classes found in the ripgrep differential residuals (2026-08-28): (1) scoped enum-variant struct literals (MatchStrategy::Suffix { .. }) must emit instantiates to the VARIANT LEAF (Suffix), not silently drop; (2) bare tuple-struct constructors (Hasher(0)) must emit instantiates Hasher; (3) ::new receivers emit instantiates of the receiver TYPE; (4) turbofish calls (x.parse::<u32>()) must target the callee LEAF (parse), never the whole base text. A regression on any of these fails this fixture.
